scope: One actual macOS CLI install recovery and pinned-file verification. Model initialization/inference/quality and native GUI recovery are not covered.

retained_failures.error: read model download / timeout: receive response

retained_failures.reason: Quiet nc probe supplied no error text for strict permission-denial proof; preflight stopped before any catalog/settings/install/verify command.
retained_failures.correction: Documented nc-v exposes permission failure. Same listener, arguments and denial criterion; no weakened gate.
retained_failures.limit: Canary PIDs were not persisted before that failed gate; reaping is code-observed, not independently PID-receipted.

network_control.method: Same owned loopback listener, nc-z-v-w1 control0 versus denied nonzero with explicit OS permission error; metadata and verify use that same deny-network policy.
network_control.inference_traffic: No inference or provider call was executed.
network_control.limit: Not a packet trace, recipient capture check or full offline session. HTTPS model acquisition is intentional and distinct from inference.

limits: Installation and SHA verification do not establish that Candle can initialize this7B model, its memory use, answer/highlights quality or real-time latency. These remain unrun.
Source-derived12–14GiB memory estimate is not a measurement or upper bound. Default1.5B/base.en selections are unchanged.
The sampled partial never fell below its initial size; actual HTTP206/Range response headers were not retained, so no wire-byte or HTTP-status claim is made.
Raw commercial binaries/private captures/credentials and model payloads are absent from this public report. Open model files remain outside the repository.
GUI cancellation/permissions/audio/screen, first-use/distribution, other-platform hardware, sustained operation and matched reference acceptance remain open.
